external_scope: Author reports rm_kq=1 small RADV gain and larger AMDVLK gain on old Qwen3.5 stack; not local evidence.
interpretation: Local floating input K-quant pipelines use rm_kq=2; integer Q8_1 input paths independently use rm_kq_int=1.
Captured trace includes Q6_K F32 input with two rows and two columns: smaller row packing is a candidate, not a proven improvement.
Changing native rm_kq alone does not change embedded mega op implementations and is not a fair mega improvement comparison.
Do not alter PCIe/clock/driver system settings. Retain explicit private ICD and load/clock gates.
status: Research/source/trace evidence only. No implementation or performance claim.
